text: {"reason":"Replace the medium/high supplier action with alert-planner: it costs 35,000 versus 45,000 and always arrives in time. This removes supplier-induced stockouts, including the failing medium rows at 5.3 and 2.8 days. Across 40 events, projected cost falls from 2,165,000 to 1,225,000 and stockouts from 4 to 0.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days) (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) (else (list 'monitor))))"}
